components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant action in any group. Terracotta on parchment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C7562C; color: #F9F5EF; padding: 8px 20px; height: 32px; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C7562CCC; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C7562C80; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editorial Button
components.description: Brand register only. Sharp, uppercase, ink-bordered.
components.css: .ds-btn-editorial { background: transparent; color: #252525; padding: 10px 20px; height: 40px; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #252525; border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-editorial:hover { background: #252525; color: #F9F5EF; } .ds-btn-editorial:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C7562C80; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input with transparent background and bottom-border focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #252525; padding: 4px 10px; height: 32px; font-family: DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid rgba(37,37,37,0.15); border-radius: 0; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C7562C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,86,44,0.15); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #746E68; }

narrative.overview: A master drafting table: paper, brass instruments, clean lines. Work is visible, organized, and beautiful in its precision but never decorative for its own sake. This design system operates in two registers from the same token set. The brand register (homepage, marketing pages) uses serif display type, sharper corners, and more generous whitespace it is the invitation. The product register (dashboards, forms, pipelines, tables) uses the same colors and type families but composes them with more density, consistent rounded corners, and functional hierarchy it is the instrument.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment base with ink-black text and a single terracotta accent
Serif for display headlines only; sans-serif for everything else
Sharp editorial corners reserved for brand surfaces; product surfaces use 8px consistently
Elevation through tonal layering, not shadow

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary terracotta appears on <=10% of any functional screen. Never use it for decorative backgrounds, hover fills on large areas, or border accents.

rules.name: The Serif Reservation Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears only in the brand register and in dialog titles. Never in tables, forms, cards, pipelines, or admin dashboards.

rules.name: The No-Card-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, containers, and panels do not carry shadow at rest. Their elevation is communicated by background color shift or by a 1px ring at 10% foreground opacity.

dos: Do use DM Serif Display for display headlines on marketing pages and modal titles only.
Do use the terracotta accent on <=10% of any functional screen.
Do respect the surface stack in dark mode.
Do use logical CSS properties for all layout.
Do collapse all motion to instant state changes when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
Do pair color with icon or text label for every status indicator.
donts: Don't use DM Serif Display inside tables, forms, candidate pipelines, or admin dashboards.
Don't use rounded-none on inputs, buttons, or cards inside dashboard surfaces.
Don't use the terracotta accent for decorative hover backgrounds on large cards, sidebar items, or table rows.
Don't use gradient text, gradient backgrounds, or glassmorphism anywhere.
Don't use side-stripe borders as colored accents on cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't use the hero-metric template for dashboard stats.
Don't use identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly.
Don't reach for a modal before exhausting inline or progressive alternatives.
Don't use em dashes in any copy.
